title: Documents: Jeff Bezos has invested $30B in Blue Origin since 2000, including $2B in its first outside funding round, which has raised $10B at a $140B valuation (Micah Maidenberg/Wall Street Journal)
summary: Micah Maidenberg / Wall Street Journal: Documents: Jeff Bezos has invested $30B in Blue Origin since 2000, including $2B in its first outside funding round, which has raised $10B at a $140B valuation — The space company wants to rapidly boost revenue in the coming years, betting its rockets will make it a powerful industry player
